text: Oracle Revenue Management & Billing — Healthcare Edition Premium Billing · Member Enrollment · Coverage Management · Rate Structures · Regulatory Compliance

Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) in a Healthcare context manages the full premium revenue lifecycle — from group and member enrollment through premium invoicing, payment collection, and regulatory reporting.
This knowledge base covers individual member billing, group employer billing, enrollment, coverage, rate structures, and compliance. Claims processing and provider billing are out of scope.

text: Handles the full member lifecycle via CI_MEMBERSHIP and CI_MEMBERSHIP_PER. New enrollments — via 834 EDI or manual entry — create Membership records linked to the appropriate SA. Mid-term changes (dependent adds/removals, plan changes) update existing membership records and may trigger retroactive premium recalculations.

Employer groups are structured as Parent Groups (CI_PER where PER_OR_BUS_FLG = 'PG') containing one or more Bill Groups (BG), linked via CI_PER_PER. Each Bill Group is associated with a billing account via CI_ACCT_PER. This allows flexible billing splits within a single employer — for example billing different divisions separately.

A Policy (CI_POLICY) is linked to the Parent Group via CI_POLICY_PER and to Plans via CI_POLICY_PLAN. Each Plan links to Memberships via PLAN_ID on CI_MEMBERSHIP. The Policy is the coverage contract umbrella; Plans are the specific benefit offerings within it.

Generates monthly premium invoices at the CI_ACCT level (Bill Group account). Premium amounts are calculated by the rating engine using the rate schedule on the SA. Supports both prospective and retroactive billing.
Processes premium payments via EFT/ACH, check, credit card, and government remittances. Distributes payments across SAs via CI_PAY_SEG. Manages payment reversals and NSF handling.
Handles premium recalculations triggered by retroactive enrollment events. Generates debit or credit FTs that appear as adjustments on the next bill.
Produces IRS 1095-B/1095-C forms, supports CMS premium reconciliation, and generates state insurance department filings using data from CI_SA, CI_MEMBERSHIP, and CI_FT.
All large-scale operations run as scheduled batch jobs: monthly billing cycles, payment matching, 834 EDI processing, and regulatory extract generation. Monitor via CI_BATCH_RUN.
⚠️ Safety Rules:
Always query a read-only replica in production.
Add FETCH FIRST N ROWS ONLY when exploring large tables.
Never run unbounded queries on CI_FT, CI_BILL, or CI_BSEG in production.
Use bind variables (:param) — never string concatenation.
Member data is PHI under HIPAA. Follow your organization's data access policies before querying.

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 5.1 Member Lookup by Name, RMRN or SSN
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Search for a member person record using name, RMRN, or SSN.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Member lookup by name, RMRN, or SSN
SELECT
    p.PER_ID,
    pn_p.ENTITY_NAME                       AS member_name,
    p.BIRTH_DT                          AS date_of_birth,
    p.EMAILID                           AS email,
    pid_rmrn.PER_ID_NBR                 AS rmrn,
    pid_ssn.PER_ID_NBR                  AS ssn,
    mp.MEMBERSHIP_ID,
    m.START_DT                          AS membership_start,
    m.END_DT                            AS membership_end,
    m.BO_STATUS_CD                      AS membership_status,
    m.EXT_MEMBER_ID                     AS external_member_id
FROM   CI_PER               p
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_PER_NAME           pn_p  ON  pn_p.PER_ID       = p.PER_ID
                                             AND pn_p.PRIM_NAME_SW = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN CI_PER_ID         pid_rmrn  ON  pid_rmrn.PER_ID  = p.PER_ID
                                      AND pid_rmrn.ID_TYPE_CD  = 'RMRN'
LEFT JOIN CI_PER_ID         pid_ssn   ON  pid_ssn.PER_ID   = p.PER_ID
                                      AND pid_ssn.ID_TYPE_CD   = 'SSN'
LEFT JOIN CI_MEMBERSHIP_PER mp        ON  mp.PER_ID         = p.PER_ID
LEFT JOIN CI_MEMBERSHIP     m         ON  m.MEMBERSHIP_ID   = mp.MEMBERSHIP_ID
WHERE  p.PER_OR_BUS_FLG = 'P'
  AND  (
        UPPER(pn_p.ENTITY_NAME)   LIKE UPPER('%' || :search_name  || '%')
   OR   pid_rmrn.PER_ID_NBR    = :rmrn
   OR   pid_ssn.PER_ID_NBR     = :ssn
  )
FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 5.5 Premium Bill Summary for an Account
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Show premium bills for a Bill Group account with charge amounts and coverage dates. Charges are derived by joining CI_BILL → CI_BSEG → CI_FT → C1_FT_EXT.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Premium bill summary for an account (last 12 months)
-- CI_BILL has no amount columns; amounts come from CI_FT
-- CI_FT joins to CI_BSEG via SIBLING_ID, to CI_BILL via PARENT_ID, and to CI_SA via SA_ID
SELECT
    b.BILL_ID,
    b.BILL_DT                           AS bill_date,
    b.DUE_DT                            AS due_date,
    b.BILL_STAT_FLG                     AS status,        -- C=Complete, P=Pending, X=Cancelled
    bs.BSEG_ID,
    bs.BSEG_STAT_FLG                    AS segment_status,
    ft.FT_ID,
    ft.SA_ID,
    sa.SA_TYPE_CD                       AS plan_type,
    ft.CUR_AMT                          AS charge_amount,
    ft.FROZEN_SW                        AS is_frozen,
    fte.START_DT                        AS coverage_start,
    fte.END_DT                          AS coverage_end
FROM   CI_BILL      b
-- Bill → Bill Segment
JOIN   CI_BSEG      bs   ON  bs.BILL_ID     = b.BILL_ID
-- Bill Segment → Financial Transaction
--   SIBLING_ID links FT to BSEG, PARENT_ID links FT to BILL
JOIN   CI_FT        ft   ON  ft.SIBLING_ID  = bs.BSEG_ID
                         AND ft.PARENT_ID   = b.BILL_ID
                         AND ft.FT_TYPE_FLG IN ( 'BS','BX')        -- Bill Segment charges only
-- FT → SA directly via SA_ID on CI_FT
JOIN   CI_SA        sa   ON  sa.SA_ID       = ft.SA_ID
-- FT → Coverage dates
JOIN   C1_FT_EXT    fte  ON  fte.FT_ID      = ft.FT_ID
WHERE  b.ACCT_ID        = :acct_id
  AND  b.BILL_STAT_FLG IN ('C')
  AND  b.BILL_DT        >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -12)
ORDER BY b.BILL_DT DESC, bs.BSEG_ID;

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 5.5 Premium Bill Summary for an Account
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: 📝 To get a total charge per bill, wrap in an aggregation:
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
SELECT b.BILL_ID, b.BILL_DT, b.DUE_DT, b.BILL_STAT_FLG,
       SUM(ft.CUR_AMT) AS total_premium_charged
FROM   CI_BILL b
JOIN   CI_BSEG  bs  ON  bs.BILL_ID     = b.BILL_ID
JOIN   CI_FT    ft  ON  ft.SIBLING_ID  = bs.BSEG_ID
                    AND ft.PARENT_ID   = b.BILL_ID
                    AND ft.FT_TYPE_FLG IN ( 'BS','BX','AD','AX')
WHERE  b.ACCT_ID = :acct_id
  AND  b.BILL_STAT_FLG IN ('C')
GROUP BY b.BILL_ID, b.BILL_DT, b.DUE_DT, b.BILL_STAT_FLG
ORDER BY b.BILL_DT DESC;

sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Show the SA(s) linked to a membership including plan type, status, and rate schedule.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Coverage SA status for a membership
SELECT
    m.MEMBERSHIP_ID,
    m.START_DT                          AS membership_start,
    m.END_DT                            AS membership_end,
    m.BO_STATUS_CD                      AS membership_status,
    m.EXT_MEMBER_ID                     AS external_member_id,
    sa.SA_ID,
    sa.SA_TYPE_CD                       AS plan_type,
    sa.START_DT                         AS coverage_start,
    sa.END_DT                           AS coverage_end,
    sa.RATE_CD                          AS rate_schedule,
    a.ACCT_ID,
    bg.PER_ID                           AS bill_group_id,
    pn_bg.ENTITY_NAME                      AS bill_group_name,
    an_a.ACCT_NBR,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 1)  AS region,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 2)  AS grp,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 3)  AS subgroup
FROM   CI_MEMBERSHIP        m
JOIN   CI_MEMBERSHIP_SA     ms   ON  ms.MEMBERSHIP_ID  = m.MEMBERSHIP_ID
JOIN   CI_SA                sa   ON  sa.SA_ID           = ms.SA_ID
JOIN   CI_ACCT              a    ON  a.ACCT_ID          = sa.ACCT_ID
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_ACCT_NBR           an_a  ON  an_a.ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_ID
                                             AND an_a.PRIM_SW   = 'Y'
JOIN   CI_ACCT_PER          ap   ON  ap.ACCT_ID         = a.ACCT_ID
JOIN   CI_PER               bg   ON  bg.PER_ID          = ap.PER_ID
                                 AND bg.PER_OR_BUS_FLG  = 'BG'
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_PER_NAME           pn_bg  ON  pn_bg.PER_ID       = bg.PER_ID
                                             AND pn_bg.PRIM_NAME_SW = 'Y'
WHERE  m.MEMBERSHIP_ID = :membership_id
ORDER BY sa.START_DT DESC;

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 5.8 Aged Premium Receivables by Customer Class
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Aggregate outstanding balances with aging buckets using CI_FT charges and CI_BILL due dates.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Aged premium receivables by customer class
SELECT
    a.CUST_CL_CD                        AS customer_class,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.ACCT_ID)           AS account_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.DUE_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
              THEN ft.CUR_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS current_balance,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.DUE_DT BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE)-30
                              AND   TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1
              THEN ft.CUR_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_1_30_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.DUE_DT BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE)-60
                              AND   TRUNC(SYSDATE)-31
              THEN ft.CUR_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_31_60_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.DUE_DT BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE)-90
                              AND   TRUNC(SYSDATE)-61
              THEN ft.CUR_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_61_90_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.DUE_DT < TRUNC(SYSDATE)-90
              THEN ft.CUR_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_90_plus_days,
    an_a.ACCT_NBR,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 1)  AS region,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 2)  AS grp,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 3)  AS subgroup
FROM   CI_ACCT    a
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_ACCT_NBR           an_a  ON  an_a.ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_ID
                                             AND an_a.PRIM_SW   = 'Y'
JOIN   CI_SA      sa   ON  sa.ACCT_ID        = a.ACCT_ID
JOIN   CI_BSEG    bs   ON  bs.SA_ID          = sa.SA_ID
JOIN   CI_BILL    b    ON  b.BILL_ID         = bs.BILL_ID
                       AND b.BILL_STAT_FLG    = 'C'
JOIN   CI_FT      ft   ON  ft.SIBLING_ID     = bs.BSEG_ID
                       AND ft.PARENT_ID      = b.BILL_ID
                       AND ft.FT_TYPE_FLG    = 'BS'
                       AND ft.FROZEN_SW      = 'Y'
GROUP BY a.CUST_CL_CD
ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC;

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 5.9 Current Bill Balance
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Current bill balance per account — derived from frozen financial transactions. ORIG_BILL_AMT is the sum of bill segment amounts; CURR_BILL_BAL is the remaining balance calculated as unmatched frozen FTs plus matched frozen FTs on still-open, undisputed match events. This is the correct way to determine outstanding balance — there is no balance column on CI_SA.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Current bill balance per account
-- ORIG_BILL_AMT = sum of bill segment amounts on the bill
-- CURR_BILL_BAL = unmatched frozen FTs + matched frozen FTs on open/undisputed match events
SELECT
    bill_id,
    acct_id,
    bill_stat_flg,
    bill_dt,
    due_dt,
    cre_dttm,
    currency_cd,
    alt_bill_id,
    orig_bill_amt,
    curr_bill_bal
FROM (
    SELECT
        blamt.bill_id,
        blamt.acct_id,
        blamt.bill_stat_flg,
        blamt.bill_dt,
        blamt.due_dt,
        blamt.cre_dttm,
        blamt.currency_cd,
        blamt.alt_bill_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(blamt.b_cur_amt), 0)           AS orig_bill_amt,
        -- Unmatched FTs (MATCH_EVT_ID is blank) for this bill
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cur_amt), 0)
         FROM (
             SELECT DISTINCT uft.*,
                    uft.bill_id AS bill_id_1
             FROM   cisadm.CI_FT        uft
             JOIN   cisadm.CI_SA        ufts ON ufts.sa_id    = uft.sa_id
                                           AND ufts.acct_id   = blamt.acct_id
             WHERE  uft.FT_TYPE_FLG    IN ('AD','AX','BS','BX')
               AND  uft.FREEZE_SW       = 'Y'
               AND  SUBSTR(uft.MATCH_EVT_ID, 1, 1) = ' '
         ) uft_inner
         WHERE uft_inner.bill_id_1 = blamt.bill_id
        )
        +
        -- Matched FTs where match event is still open and not disputed
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mft_inner.cur_amt), 0)
         FROM (
             SELECT DISTINCT mft.ft_id,
                    mft.cur_amt,
                    all_ft.bill_id AS bill_id_1
             FROM   cisadm.CI_FT        all_ft
             JOIN   cisadm.CI_MATCH_EVT me   ON  me.MATCH_EVT_ID    = all_ft.MATCH_EVT_ID
                                            AND  me.MEVT_STATUS_FLG  = 'O'
                                            AND  me.DISPUTE_SW       = 'N'
             JOIN   cisadm.CI_FT        mft  ON  mft.SA_ID           = all_ft.sa_id
                                            AND  TRIM(mft.MATCH_EVT_ID) = TRIM(all_ft.MATCH_EVT_ID)
                                            AND  mft.MATCH_EVT_ID    = me.MATCH_EVT_ID
                                            AND  mft.FT_TYPE_FLG    IN ('AD','AX','BS','BX','PS','PX')
                                            AND  mft.FREEZE_SW       = 'Y'
             WHERE  all_ft.FT_TYPE_FLG IN ('AD','AX','BS','BX')
               AND  all_ft.FREEZE_SW    = 'Y'
               AND  all_ft.bill_id      = blamt.bill_id
         ) mft_inner
        )                                           AS curr_bill_bal
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            bill.bill_id,
            bill.acct_id,
            bill.bill_stat_flg,
            bill.bill_dt,
            bill.due_dt,
            bill.cre_dttm,
            bill.alt_bill_id,
            bsa.sa_id                               AS b_sa_id,
            bsa.CUR_AMT                             AS b_cur_amt,
            COALESCE(bsa.currency_cd, ac.currency_cd) AS currency_cd
        FROM   cisadm.CI_BILL       bill
        JOIN   cisadm.CI_SA         asa  ON  asa.acct_id  = bill.acct_id
        LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_BILL_SA bsa  ON  bsa.bill_id  = bill.bill_id
                                        AND  bsa.sa_id    = asa.sa_id
        JOIN   cisadm.CI_ACCT       ac   ON  ac.acct_id   = bill.acct_id
        WHERE  asa.sa_status_flg IN ('10','20','30','50')
          AND  bill.acct_id = :acct_id
    ) blamt
    GROUP BY
        blamt.bill_id,
        blamt.acct_id,
        blamt.bill_stat_flg,
        blamt.bill_dt,
        blamt.due_dt,
        blamt.cre_dttm,
        blamt.currency_cd,
        blamt.alt_bill_id
)
ORDER BY bill_dt DESC;

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 5.10 Financial Transactions for an Account
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Retrieve FT records with type, amount, running balance, and SA context (last 90 days). CI_FT carries SA_ID directly. For adjustment FTs (AD/AX), SIBLING_ID joins to CI_ADJ.ADJ_ID. For bill segment FTs (BS/BX), SIBLING_ID joins to CI_BSEG.BSEG_ID.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Financial transactions for an account (last 90 days)
-- FT types: BS=Bill Seg, BX=Bill Seg Cancel, PS=Pay Seg, PX=Pay Seg Cancel,
--           AD=Adjustment, AX=Adjustment Cancel
SELECT
    ft.FT_ID,
    ft.FT_TYPE_FLG                      AS ft_type,
    ft.ACCOUNTING_DT                    AS accounting_date,
    ft.CUR_AMT                          AS amount,
    ft.CUR_BAL                          AS running_balance,
    ft.FROZEN_SW                        AS is_frozen,
    ft.PARENT_ID                        AS bill_id,
    ft.SIBLING_ID                       AS sibling_id,    -- BSEG_ID or ADJ_ID depending on type
    ft.SA_ID,
    sa.SA_TYPE_CD                       AS plan_type,
    -- Adjustment details (populated for AD/AX only)
    adj.ADJ_ID,
    adj.ADJ_TYPE_CD                     AS adj_type,
    adj.ADJ_AMT                         AS adj_amount,
    adj.ADJ_STATUS_FLG                  AS adj_status,
    DECODE(ft.FT_TYPE_FLG,
        'BS', 'Bill Segment',
        'BX', 'Bill Segment Cancellation',
        'PS', 'Payment Segment',
        'PX', 'Payment Segment Cancellation',
        'AD', 'Adjustment',
        'AX', 'Adjustment Cancellation',
        ft.FT_TYPE_FLG)                AS ft_type_label
FROM   CI_FT    ft
-- FT → SA directly via SA_ID
JOIN   CI_SA    sa   ON  sa.SA_ID  = ft.SA_ID
-- FT → Adjustment (only joins when FT is AD or AX)
LEFT JOIN CI_ADJ adj ON  adj.ADJ_ID = ft.SIBLING_ID
                     AND ft.FT_TYPE_FLG IN ('AD', 'AX')
WHERE  ft.ACCT_ID       = :acct_id
  AND  ft.ACCOUNTING_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 90
ORDER BY ft.ACCOUNTING_DT DESC, ft.FT_ID DESC;

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 5.11 Batch Job Diagnostic
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Monitor batch job runs for the last 1 days.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement: SELECT    brun.BATCH_CD,    brun.BATCH_NBR,    brun.BATCH_RERUN_NBR,    MAX(binst.BATCH_THREAD_NBR) THREAD_CNT,    brun.BATCH_BUS_DT,    SUM(binst.REC_PROC_CNT) REC_PROC_CNT,    SUM(binst.REC_ERR_CNT) REC_ERR_CNT,    brun.START_DTTM,    brun.END_DTTM,    ROUND((brun.END_DTTM - brun.START_DTTM)*60*24, 2) DURATION_MIN,    ROUND((brun.END_DTTM - brun.START_DTTM)*60*60*24, 2) DURATION_SEC,    ROUND(SUM(binst.REC_PROC_CNT) / ((brun.END_DTTM - brun.START_DTTM)*60*60*24) , 2) REC_PER_SECFROM    cisadm.CI_BATCH_RUN brun,    cisadm.CI_BATCH_INST binstWHERE      brun.BATCH_CD = binst.BATCH_CD    AND brun.BATCH_NBR = binst.BATCH_NBR    AND brun.BATCH_RERUN_NBR = binst.BATCH_RERUN_NBR    AND brun.BATCH_NBR >= (SELECT MAX(brn.BATCH_NBR) FROM cisadm.CI_BATCH_RUN brn WHERE brn.BATCH_CD = brun.BATCH_CD)-10    AND brun.BATCH_BUS_DT  = TRUNC(SYSDATE)   GROUP BY    brun.BATCH_CD,    brun.BATCH_NBR,    brun.BATCH_RERUN_NBR,    brun.BATCH_BUS_DT,    brun.START_DTTM,    brun.END_DTTMORDER BY start_Dttm asc;

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 5.12 Rating Rules for All Plans Within a Policy
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Join chain:
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Rating rules for all plans within a policy
-- Parses BO_DATA_AREA XML to extract age bands, fees, and pricing parameters
SELECT
    pp.PLAN_ID,
    pp.PLAN_NBR,
    pp.START_DT                         AS plan_start,
    pp.END_DT                           AS plan_end,
    po.POLICY_NBR,
    q.PRCRULEID                         AS pricing_rule_id,
    q.START_DT                          AS prc_rule_start,
    q.END_DT                            AS prc_rule_end,
    q.BO_STATUS_CD                      AS prc_rule_status,
    q.SEQNUM                            AS price_item_seq,
    q.FEE                               AS fee_amount,
    q.LOWERAGELIMIT                     AS age_lower,
    q.UPPERAGELIMIT                     AS age_upper,
    q.PARAM_SEQNUM                      AS param_seq,
    q.PRICEITEMPARAMETER                AS parameter_name,
    q.PRICEITEMPARAMETERVALUE           AS parameter_value
FROM (
    -- Parse BO_DATA_AREA XML on C1_PRC_RULE
    -- Outer XMLTABLE: extracts priceItemParmList rows (one per age band / fee tier)
    -- Inner XMLTABLE: extracts priceItemParameters rows (one per parameter per tier)
    SELECT
        t.PRICING_RULE_ID               AS prcruleid,
        t.START_DT,
        t.END_DT,
        t.BO_STATUS_CD,
        x.SEQNUM,
        x.FEE,
        x.RCMAPID,
        x.LOWERAGELIMIT,
        x.UPPERAGELIMIT,
        p.PARAM_SEQNUM,
        p.PRICEITEMPARAMETER,
        p.PRICEITEMPARAMETERVALUE
    FROM cisadm.C1_PRC_RULE t,
        -- First XMLTABLE: parses priceItemParmList entries from BO_DATA_AREA
        XMLTABLE('root/extendedData/priceItemParmList'
            PASSING XMLTYPE('<root>' || t.BO_DATA_AREA || '</root>')
            COLUMNS
                SEQNUM              VARCHAR2(100)   PATH 'seqNum',
                FEE                 VARCHAR2(100)   PATH 'fee',
                RCMAPID             VARCHAR2(100)   PATH 'rcMapId',
                LOWERAGELIMIT       VARCHAR2(100)   PATH 'lowerAgeLimit',
                UPPERAGELIMIT       VARCHAR2(100)   PATH 'upperAgeLimit',
                PARAMETERS          XMLTYPE         PATH 'priceItemParameters'
        ) x,
        -- Second XMLTABLE: parses priceItemParameters child nodes from each parmList row
        XMLTABLE('priceItemParameters'
            PASSING x.PARAMETERS
            COLUMNS
                PARAM_SEQNUM            VARCHAR2(100)   PATH 'seqNum',
                PRICEITEMPARAMETER      VARCHAR2(100)   PATH 'priceItemParameter',
                PRICEITEMPARAMETERVALUE VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH 'priceItemParameterValue'
        ) p
) q
JOIN cisadm.C1_PRC_RULE_ENTITY  pe  ON  pe.PRICING_RULE_ID      = q.PRCRULEID
JOIN cisadm.CI_POLICY_PLAN      pp  ON  pp.PLAN_ID               = pe.PRC_RULE_ENTITY_ID
JOIN cisadm.CI_POLICY           po  ON  po.POLICY_ID             = pp.POLICY_ID
WHERE  po.POLICY_NBR = :policy_nbr
ORDER BY pp.PLAN_NBR, q.SEQNUM, q.PARAM_SEQNUM;

text: Step 1 — Access & Credentials Request VPN access, ORMB application login, and database read-only credentials. Complete mandatory HIPAA training before accessing member data. Confirm your role and permitted data scope.
Step 2 — Understand the Two Key Hierarchies
There are two paths through the data model and you need to know both:
Billing path: CI_PER (PG) → CI_PER_PER → CI_PER (BG) → CI_ACCT_PER → CI_ACCT → CI_SA → CI_MEMBERSHIP_SA → CI_MEMBERSHIP → CI_MEMBERSHIP_PER → CI_PER (P)
Policy path: CI_PER (PG) → CI_POLICY_PER → CI_POLICY → CI_POLICY_PLAN → CI_MEMBERSHIP

Step 3 — Always Filter CI_PER by PER_OR_BUS_FLG CI_PER holds Parent Groups (PG), Bill Groups (BG), and individual members (P) in the same table. Always include a PER_OR_BUS_FLG filter in your queries or results will mix all three types.

Step 4 — Tool Setup Install Oracle SQL Developer or DBeaver. Obtain the JDBC connection string from your DBA. Always use bind variables (:param) in queries — never concatenate user input into SQL strings.

Step 5 — Run Your First Queries Use a known test Membership ID and run Query 5.2 (Member Roster). Then use the returned SA_ID to run Query 5.6 (Coverage SA Status) and cross-check against the ORMB UI.

text: Revenue recognition in ORMB manages the process of moving premium revenue from unearned to earned status as coverage periods are consumed. When a bill segment or adjustment FT is created, a revenue recognition schedule (CI_REV_REC_SCH) is generated. The recognition engine then processes each schedule and creates recognition items (CI_REV_REC_ITEM), each backed by an adjustment (CI_ADJ) that performs the actual GL accounting movement.

tables.tableDescription: Revenue recognition in ORMB manages the process of moving premium revenue from unearned to earned status as coverage periods are consumed. When a bill segment or adjustment FT is created, a revenue recognition schedule (CI_REV_REC_SCH) is generated. The recognition engine then processes each schedule and creates recognition items (CI_REV_REC_ITEM), each backed by an adjustment (CI_ADJ) that performs the actual GL accounting movement.
tables.tableContent:
Concept | Description
Unearned Revenue | Premium received or billed but not yet earned — coverage period has not yet elapsed
Earned Revenue | Premium recognised as earned because the coverage period has passed
DRR Template | Deferred Revenue Recognition template (DRR_TEMPLATE_CD) — defines how revenue is spread across periods (e.g. straight-line monthly)
Recognition Schedule | CI_REV_REC_SCH — one record per FT that needs recognition. Created when the FT is frozen.
Recognition Item | CI_REV_REC_ITEM — one row per recognition event on a schedule. ADJ_ID is null until the recognition batch runs.
VALID_UNTIL_DT | The latest date by which all revenue on a schedule must be recognised. Typically equals coverage end date.
BO_STATUS_CD | Processing status of the recognition schedule — pending, in progress, complete, error. Decode via CI_LOOKUP_VAL.

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 7.3 Query: Revenue Recognition Schedule for an SA
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Retrieve all recognition schedules for a service agreement, showing the source FT, template, and processing status.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Revenue recognition schedules for an SA
SELECT
    rrs.REV_REC_ID,
    rrs.FT_ID,
    rrs.SA_ID,
    rrs.DST_ID                          AS distribution_id,
    rrs.DRR_TEMPLATE_CD                 AS recognition_template,
    rrs.BO_STATUS_CD                    AS schedule_status,
    rrs.VALID_UNTIL_DT                  AS valid_until,
    rrs.CRE_DTTM                        AS schedule_created,
    rrs.STATUS_UPD_DTTM                 AS last_status_update,
    -- Source FT detail
    ft.FT_TYPE_FLG                      AS ft_type,
    ft.CUR_AMT                          AS ft_amount,
    ft.ACCOUNTING_DT                    AS ft_accounting_date,
    ft.FREEZE_SW                        AS ft_frozen,
    DECODE(ft.FT_TYPE_FLG,
        'BS', 'Bill Segment',
        'BX', 'Bill Segment Cancellation',
        'AD', 'Adjustment',
        'AX', 'Adjustment Cancellation',
        ft.FT_TYPE_FLG)                AS ft_type_label
FROM   CI_REV_REC_SCH   rrs
JOIN   CI_FT            ft   ON  ft.FT_ID  = rrs.FT_ID
WHERE  rrs.SA_ID = :sa_id
ORDER BY rrs.CRE_DTTM DESC;

sections.sectionTitle: 7.4 Query: Recognition Items — Earned vs Pending
sectionPath: 7.4 Query: Recognition Items — Earned vs Pending

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 7.4 Query: Recognition Items — Earned vs Pending
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Show all recognition items for a schedule, including which have been processed (have an ADJ_ID) and which are still pending.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Recognition items for a schedule — earned vs pending
SELECT
    rrs.REV_REC_ID,
    rrs.SA_ID,
    rrs.DRR_TEMPLATE_CD                 AS recognition_template,
    rrs.BO_STATUS_CD                    AS schedule_status,
    rrs.VALID_UNTIL_DT                  AS valid_until,
    -- Recognition item
    rri.DRR_SEQ_NUM                     AS seq_num,
    rri.RECOG_DT                        AS recognition_date,
    rri.RECOG_AMT                       AS recognised_amount,
    rri.ADJ_ID,
    CASE WHEN rri.ADJ_ID IS NOT NULL
         THEN 'Earned'
         ELSE 'Pending'
    END                                 AS recognition_status,
    -- Adjustment detail (populated once recognition batch runs)
    adj.ADJ_TYPE_CD                     AS adj_type,
    adj.ADJ_AMT                         AS adj_amount,
    adj.ADJ_STATUS_FLG                  AS adj_status,
    adj.SA_ID                           AS adj_sa_id
FROM   CI_REV_REC_SCH    rrs
JOIN   CI_REV_REC_ITEM   rri  ON  rri.REV_REC_ID = rrs.REV_REC_ID
LEFT JOIN CI_ADJ         adj  ON  adj.ADJ_ID      = rri.ADJ_ID  -- NULL until batch runs
WHERE  rrs.REV_REC_ID = :rev_rec_id
ORDER BY rri.DRR_SEQ_NUM;

sections.sectionTitle: 7.5 Query: Full Revenue Recognition Chain for an Account
sectionPath: 7.5 Query: Full Revenue Recognition Chain for an Account

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 7.5 Query: Full Revenue Recognition Chain for an Account
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Traverse the full chain from account → SA → FT → recognition schedule → recognition items for a given period.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Full revenue recognition chain for an account
SELECT
    a.ACCT_ID,
    sa.SA_ID,
    sa.SA_TYPE_CD                       AS plan_type,
    -- Source financial transaction
    ft.FT_ID,
    ft.FT_TYPE_FLG,
    ft.CUR_AMT                          AS ft_amount,
    ft.ACCOUNTING_DT,
    -- Recognition schedule
    rrs.REV_REC_ID,
    rrs.DRR_TEMPLATE_CD                 AS template,
    rrs.BO_STATUS_CD                    AS schedule_status,
    rrs.VALID_UNTIL_DT,
    -- Recognition items
    rri.DRR_SEQ_NUM                     AS seq_num,
    rri.RECOG_DT                        AS recognition_date,
    rri.RECOG_AMT                       AS recognised_amount,
    CASE WHEN rri.ADJ_ID IS NOT NULL
         THEN 'Earned'
         ELSE 'Pending'
    END                                 AS recognition_status,
    rri.ADJ_ID,
    -- Earning adjustment
    adj.ADJ_TYPE_CD                     AS adj_type,
    adj.ADJ_AMT                         AS adj_amount,
    adj.ADJ_STATUS_FLG                  AS adj_status,
    an_a.ACCT_NBR,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 1)  AS region,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 2)  AS grp,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 3)  AS subgroup
FROM   CI_ACCT           a
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_ACCT_NBR           an_a  ON  an_a.ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_ID
                                             AND an_a.PRIM_SW   = 'Y'
JOIN   CI_SA             sa   ON  sa.ACCT_ID      = a.ACCT_ID
JOIN   CI_FT             ft   ON  ft.SA_ID        = sa.SA_ID
                              AND ft.FT_TYPE_FLG  IN ('BS','BX','AD','AX')
                              AND ft.FREEZE_SW    = 'Y'
JOIN   CI_REV_REC_SCH    rrs  ON  rrs.FT_ID       = ft.FT_ID
JOIN   CI_REV_REC_ITEM   rri  ON  rri.REV_REC_ID  = rrs.REV_REC_ID
LEFT JOIN CI_ADJ         adj  ON  adj.ADJ_ID       = rri.ADJ_ID
WHERE  a.ACCT_ID    = :acct_id
  AND  rri.RECOG_DT BETWEEN :period_start AND :period_end
ORDER BY sa.SA_ID, ft.ACCOUNTING_DT, rri.RECOG_DT;

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 7.6 Query: Unrecognised Revenue (Pending Schedules)
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Identify recognition schedules where items have not yet been processed — i.e. ADJ_ID is still null and RECOG_DT is past.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Unrecognised revenue past recognition date
SELECT
    rrs.REV_REC_ID,
    rrs.SA_ID,
    rrs.FT_ID,
    rrs.DRR_TEMPLATE_CD                 AS template,
    rrs.BO_STATUS_CD                    AS schedule_status,
    rrs.VALID_UNTIL_DT,
    rri.DRR_SEQ_NUM                     AS seq_num,
    rri.RECOG_DT                        AS due_recognition_date,
    rri.RECOG_AMT                       AS unrecognised_amount,
    ft.CUR_AMT                          AS original_ft_amount,
    ft.FT_TYPE_FLG,
    sa.SA_TYPE_CD                       AS plan_type,
    a.ACCT_ID,
    an_a.ACCT_NBR,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 1)  AS region,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 2)  AS grp,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 3)  AS subgroup
FROM   CI_REV_REC_SCH    rrs
JOIN   CI_REV_REC_ITEM   rri  ON  rri.REV_REC_ID  = rrs.REV_REC_ID
JOIN   CI_FT             ft   ON  ft.FT_ID         = rrs.FT_ID
JOIN   CI_SA             sa   ON  sa.SA_ID          = rrs.SA_ID
JOIN   CI_ACCT           a    ON  a.ACCT_ID         = sa.ACCT_ID
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_ACCT_NBR           an_a  ON  an_a.ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_ID
                                             AND an_a.PRIM_SW   = 'Y'
WHERE  rri.ADJ_ID   IS NULL                 -- not yet recognised
  AND  rri.RECOG_DT  < TRUNC(SYSDATE)       -- recognition date has passed
ORDER BY rri.RECOG_DT, rrs.SA_ID;

sections.sectionTitle: 7.7 Query: Revenue Recognised in a Period (for GL / MLR Reporting)
sectionPath: 7.7 Query: Revenue Recognised in a Period (for GL / MLR Reporting)

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 7.7 Query: Revenue Recognised in a Period (for GL / MLR Reporting)
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Summarise earned revenue by SA type and recognition date for a given reporting period.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Revenue recognised in a period — summarised by plan type
SELECT
    sa.SA_TYPE_CD                       AS plan_type,
    rri.RECOG_DT                        AS recognition_date,
    COUNT(rri.DRR_SEQ_NUM)              AS item_count,
    SUM(rri.RECOG_AMT)                  AS total_recognised,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft.FT_TYPE_FLG = 'BS'
             THEN rri.RECOG_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS from_bill_segments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft.FT_TYPE_FLG IN ('AD','AX')
             THEN rri.RECOG_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS from_adjustments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft.FT_TYPE_FLG IN ('BX')
             THEN rri.RECOG_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS from_cancellations
FROM   CI_REV_REC_ITEM   rri
JOIN   CI_REV_REC_SCH    rrs  ON  rrs.REV_REC_ID  = rri.REV_REC_ID
JOIN   CI_FT             ft   ON  ft.FT_ID         = rrs.FT_ID
JOIN   CI_SA             sa   ON  sa.SA_ID          = rrs.SA_ID
WHERE  rri.ADJ_ID   IS NOT NULL                         -- processed only
  AND  rri.RECOG_DT  BETWEEN :period_start AND :period_end
GROUP BY sa.SA_TYPE_CD, rri.RECOG_DT
ORDER BY rri.RECOG_DT, sa.SA_TYPE_CD;

text: FT is frozen — When a bill segment (BS), cancellation (BX), adjustment (AD), or adjustment cancellation (AX) FT is frozen in CI_FT, the system automatically creates a CI_REV_REC_SCH record linked via FT_ID.
Schedule created — CI_REV_REC_SCH is created with BO_STATUS_CD in pending status. DRR_TEMPLATE_CD determines how revenue will be spread. VALID_UNTIL_DT is set to the coverage end date.

Recognition items generated — The recognition batch reads each pending schedule and creates one CI_REV_REC_ITEM row per recognition event (e.g. one per month of coverage). At this point ADJ_ID is null — items are pending.

Recognition batch runs — On the scheduled recognition date, the batch processes each pending item where RECOG_DT <= SYSDATE. For each item it creates a CI_ADJ that debits unearned revenue and credits earned revenue in the GL. The ADJ_ID is then written back to CI_REV_REC_ITEM.
Revenue is earned — Once ADJ_ID is populated on CI_REV_REC_ITEM, that portion of revenue is considered earned. The adjustment FT flows through to GL distribution via CI_DST.
Schedule completes — When all items on a schedule have been recognised, CI_REV_REC_SCH.BO_STATUS_CD is updated to complete status.

tables.tableDescription: Schedule completes — When all items on a schedule have been recognised, CI_REV_REC_SCH.BO_STATUS_CD is updated to complete status.
tables.tableContent:
Issue | Where to Look | Resolution
Recognition items not generated | CI_REV_REC_SCH.BO_STATUS_CD | Check schedule is in correct pending status; verify recognition batch ran
ADJ_ID still null after batch | CI_REV_REC_ITEM where RECOG_DT < SYSDATE | Check batch run in CI_BATCH_RUN; look for errors on the schedule BO_DATA_AREA
Wrong RECOG_AMT on items | CI_REV_REC_SCH.DRR_TEMPLATE_CD | Verify DRR template configuration spreads correctly across coverage period
Recognition past VALID_UNTIL_DT | CI_REV_REC_SCH.VALID_UNTIL_DT vs CI_REV_REC_ITEM.RECOG_DT | Coverage end date mismatch — check SA END_DT and FT coverage dates in C1_FT_EXT
FT has no recognition schedule | CI_REV_REC_SCH where FT_ID = :ft_id returns no rows | Verify FT type is BS/BX/AD/AX and FT is frozen (FROZEN_SW = 'Y'); check SA has DRR template assigned
GL entries not generated | CI_ADJ.ADJ_STATUS_FLG on the recognition adjustment | Adj may be pending freeze; check CI_FT for the corresponding AD FT from the recognition adj
Duplicate recognition items | Multiple CI_REV_REC_SCH rows for same FT_ID | Recognition batch may have run twice; investigate and cancel duplicate schedules

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 8.1 Overview & Pipeline
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: The GL accounting pipeline processes frozen FTs through a sequence of batch jobs, ultimately producing a summarised XML output by GL account and accounting date for downstream general ledger systems.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
CI_FT  (FROZEN_SW='Y', FT_TYPE_FLG IN 'BS','BX','AD','AX','PS','PX')
  │
  │  Step 1 — FT queued for GL
  ├── CI_FT_PROC
  │       BATCH_CD  = 'CM-GLDTL'
  │       BATCH_NBR = next CM-GLDTL batch number
  │       Tracks which FTs are selected for the GL detail run
  │
  │  Step 2 — GL entries created with dummy distribution codes
  ├── CI_FT_GL  (FT_ID = CI_FT.FT_ID)
  │       Initial creation has placeholder DIST_CD values
  │       DST_ID → CM_GL_ACCT_TEMPLATE_LINE.DST_ID
  │
  │  Step 3 — CM-UFTGL job runs
  │       Updates DIST_CD on CI_FT_GL with real distribution codes
  │       Adds C1_FT_EXT_CHAR row per FT:
  │         CHAR_TYPE_CD = 'CM-UFTGL'
  │         SRCH_CHAR_VAL = CM-UFTGL BATCH_NBR
  │
  │  Step 4 — GLASSGN job runs
  │       Assigns GL_ACCT numbers on CI_FT_GL
  │       Adds C1_FT_EXT_CHAR row per FT:
  │         CHAR_TYPE_CD = 'CMGLAT'
  │         SRCH_CHAR_VAL = CM_GLAT_ID (GL account template ID)
  │       Template details: CM_GL_ACCT_TEMPLATE_LINE
  │         joined via CI_FT_GL.DST_ID = CM_GL_ACCT_TEMPLATE_LINE.DST_ID
  │
  │  Step 5 — CM-GLDTL job runs
  │       Selects FT records by distribution date and status from CI_FT_GL
  │       Summarises by GL_ACCT + ACCOUNTING_DT
  │       Produces XML output for downstream GL system
  │       (no target database table — output is XML only)
  │
  └── C1_FT_EXT_CHAR  (FT_ID = CI_FT.FT_ID)
        ├── CHAR_TYPE_CD = 'CM-UFTGL' → SRCH_CHAR_VAL = UFTGL batch_nbr
        └── CHAR_TYPE_CD = 'CMGLAT'   → SRCH_CHAR_VAL = CM_GLAT_ID

tables.tableContent:
Step | Batch Job | What It Does | Key Table(s)
2 | System | Creates CI_FT_GL rows with dummy distribution codes | CI_FT_GL
3 | CM-UFTGL | Updates DIST_CD on CI_FT_GL; writes C1_FT_EXT_CHAR with CHAR_TYPE_CD='CM-UFTGL' | CI_FT_GL, C1_FT_EXT_CHAR
4 | GLASSGN | Assigns GL_ACCT on CI_FT_GL; writes C1_FT_EXT_CHAR with CHAR_TYPE_CD='CMGLAT' | CI_FT_GL, C1_FT_EXT_CHAR, CM_GL_ACCT_TEMPLATE_LINE
5 | GLS | GL Summary Downlaod | CI_FT
6 | CM-GLDTL (final) | Summarises CI_FT_GL by GL_ACCT + ACCOUNTING_DT; produces XML output | CI_FT_GL → XML

sections.sectionTitle: 8.3 Query: FTs Queued for GL Processing
sectionPath: 8.3 Query: FTs Queued for GL Processing

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 8.3 Query: FTs Queued for GL Processing
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Find all FTs queued for a specific CM-GLDTL batch run.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- FTs queued for GL processing via CI_FT_PROC
SELECT
    fp.FT_ID,
    fp.SEQ_NUM,
    fp.BATCH_CD,
    fp.BATCH_NBR,
    fp.SPR_CD,
    fp.ADJ_ID,
    -- Source FT detail
    ft.FT_TYPE_FLG,
    ft.ACCOUNTING_DT,
    ft.CUR_AMT,
    ft.FREEZE_SW,
    ft.SA_ID,
    ft.ACCT_ID,
    DECODE(ft.FT_TYPE_FLG,
        'BS', 'Bill Segment',
        'BX', 'Bill Segment Cancellation',
        'PS', 'Payment Segment',
        'PX', 'Payment Segment Cancellation',
        'AD', 'Adjustment',
        'AX', 'Adjustment Cancellation',
        ft.FT_TYPE_FLG)             AS ft_type_label
FROM   CI_FT_PROC   fp
JOIN   CI_FT        ft  ON  ft.FT_ID    = fp.FT_ID
WHERE  fp.BATCH_CD  = 'CM-GLDTL'
  AND  fp.BATCH_NBR = :batch_nbr
ORDER BY fp.SEQ_NUM;

sections.sectionTitle: 8.4 Query: GL Entries for an FT
sectionPath: 8.4 Query: GL Entries for an FT

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 8.4 Query: GL Entries for an FT
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Show all CI_FT_GL rows for an FT with distribution codes and GL account assignments.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- GL entries for a specific FT
SELECT
    ftgl.FT_ID,
    ftgl.GL_SEQ_NBR,
    ftgl.DST_ID,
    ftgl.CHAR_TYPE_CD,
    ftgl.CHAR_VAL,
    ftgl.AMOUNT,
    ftgl.GL_ACCT,
    ftgl.TOT_AMT_SW,
    ftgl.VALIDATE_SW,
    ftgl.GLA_VAL_DT                 AS gl_acct_validated_dt,
    ftgl.FT_GL_CATEGORY,
    ftgl.GLAT_ID,
    ftgl.GL_DL_DTL_ID,
    ftgl.STATISTIC_AMOUNT,
    -- GL account template line
    glatl.CM_GLAT_ID,
    glatl.SEQNO                     AS template_seqno,
    glatl.CR_DR_FLG,
    glatl.AMOUNT_TO_BE_USED,
    glatl.GLAT_CONDITIONAL_ALG_CD
FROM   CI_FT_GL                  ftgl
LEFT JOIN CM_GL_ACCT_TEMPLATE_LINE glatl
                                 ON  glatl.DST_ID = ftgl.DST_ID
WHERE  ftgl.FT_ID = :ft_id
ORDER BY ftgl.GL_SEQ_NBR;

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 8.5 Query: FT GL Processing Status
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Check where an FT is in the GL pipeline by inspecting C1_FT_EXT_CHAR for CM-UFTGL and CMGLAT characteristics.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- GL processing status for an FT via C1_FT_EXT_CHAR
SELECT
    ft.FT_ID,
    ft.FT_TYPE_FLG,
    ft.ACCOUNTING_DT,
    ft.CUR_AMT,
    ft.FROZEN_SW,
    -- CI_FT_PROC — queued for CM-GLDTL?
    fp.BATCH_CD                     AS gldtl_batch_cd,
    fp.BATCH_NBR                    AS gldtl_batch_nbr,
    -- CM-UFTGL step — distribution codes updated?
    uftgl.SRCH_CHAR_VAL             AS uftgl_batch_nbr,
    CASE WHEN uftgl.FT_ID IS NOT NULL
         THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No'
    END                             AS uftgl_processed,
    -- GLASSGN step — GL accounts assigned?
    glat.SRCH_CHAR_VAL              AS gl_template_id,
    CASE WHEN glat.FT_ID IS NOT NULL
         THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No'
    END                             AS gl_acct_assigned,
    -- CI_FT_GL — GL entries exist?
    COUNT(ftgl.GL_SEQ_NBR)          AS gl_entry_count,
    SUM(ftgl.AMOUNT)                AS total_gl_amount
FROM   CI_FT            ft
-- Step 1: queued for processing
LEFT JOIN CI_FT_PROC    fp     ON  fp.FT_ID       = ft.FT_ID
                               AND fp.BATCH_CD    = 'CM-GLDTL'
-- GL entries
LEFT JOIN CI_FT_GL      ftgl   ON  ftgl.FT_ID     = ft.FT_ID
-- Step 3: CM-UFTGL processed
LEFT JOIN C1_FT_EXT_CHAR uftgl ON  uftgl.FT_ID       = ft.FT_ID
                               AND uftgl.CHAR_TYPE_CD  = 'CM-UFTGL'
-- Step 4: GLASSGN assigned
LEFT JOIN C1_FT_EXT_CHAR glat  ON  glat.FT_ID        = ft.FT_ID
                               AND glat.CHAR_TYPE_CD   = 'CMGLAT'
WHERE  ft.FT_ID = :ft_id
GROUP BY ft.FT_ID, ft.FT_TYPE_FLG, ft.ACCOUNTING_DT, ft.CUR_AMT,
         ft.FROZEN_SW, fp.BATCH_CD, fp.BATCH_NBR,
         uftgl.SRCH_CHAR_VAL, uftgl.FT_ID,
         glat.SRCH_CHAR_VAL, glat.FT_ID;

sections.sectionTitle: 8.6 Query: GL Summary by Account and Accounting Date
sectionPath: 8.6 Query: GL Summary by Account and Accounting Date

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 8.6 Query: GL Summary by Account and Accounting Date
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Replicate the CM-GLDTL summarisation logic — aggregate CI_FT_GL amounts by GL_ACCT and ACCOUNTING_DT for a given batch.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- GL summary by account and accounting date (mirrors CM-GLDTL output)
SELECT
    ft.ACCOUNTING_DT,
    ftgl.GL_ACCT,
    ftgl.DST_ID,
    ftgl.CR_DR_FLG,
    ftgl.CHAR_TYPE_CD,
    glatl.CR_DR_FLG                 AS template_cr_dr,
    glatl.AMOUNT_TO_BE_USED,
    COUNT(ftgl.FT_ID)               AS ft_count,
    SUM(ftgl.AMOUNT)                AS total_amount,
    SUM(ftgl.STATISTIC_AMOUNT)      AS total_statistic_amount
FROM   CI_FT_GL                     ftgl
JOIN   CI_FT                        ft     ON  ft.FT_ID    = ftgl.FT_ID
                                           AND ft.FROZEN_SW = 'Y'
JOIN   CI_FT_PROC                   fp     ON  fp.FT_ID    = ft.FT_ID
                                           AND fp.BATCH_CD = 'CM-GLDTL'
                                           AND fp.BATCH_NBR = :batch_nbr
LEFT JOIN CM_GL_ACCT_TEMPLATE_LINE  glatl  ON  glatl.DST_ID = ftgl.DST_ID
-- Only FTs that have completed GLASSGN step
JOIN C1_FT_EXT_CHAR                 glat   ON  glat.FT_ID       = ft.FT_ID
                                           AND glat.CHAR_TYPE_CD  = 'CMGLAT'
WHERE  ftgl.VALIDATE_SW   = 'Y'
  AND  ftgl.GL_ACCT       != ' '
GROUP BY ft.ACCOUNTING_DT, ftgl.GL_ACCT, ftgl.DST_ID,
         ftgl.CR_DR_FLG, ftgl.CHAR_TYPE_CD,
         glatl.CR_DR_FLG, glatl.AMOUNT_TO_BE_USED
ORDER BY ft.ACCOUNTING_DT, ftgl.GL_ACCT;

sections.sectionTitle: 8.7 Query: FTs Missing from GL Pipeline
sectionPath: 8.7 Query: FTs Missing from GL Pipeline

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 8.7 Query: FTs Missing from GL Pipeline
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Identify frozen FTs that should be in the GL pipeline but are missing from one or more steps — useful for investigating GL reconciliation gaps.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Frozen FTs missing from GL pipeline steps
SELECT
    ft.FT_ID,
    ft.FT_TYPE_FLG,
    ft.ACCOUNTING_DT,
    ft.CUR_AMT,
    ft.SA_ID,
    ft.ACCT_ID,
    CASE WHEN fp.FT_ID  IS NULL THEN 'Missing' ELSE 'OK' END AS ci_ft_proc_status,
    CASE WHEN ftgl.FT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Missing' ELSE 'OK' END AS ci_ft_gl_status,
    CASE WHEN uftgl.FT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Done' END AS uftgl_status,
    CASE WHEN glat.FT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Done' END AS glassgn_status
FROM   CI_FT            ft
LEFT JOIN CI_FT_PROC    fp     ON  fp.FT_ID       = ft.FT_ID
                               AND fp.BATCH_CD    = 'CM-GLDTL'
LEFT JOIN CI_FT_GL      ftgl   ON  ftgl.FT_ID     = ft.FT_ID
LEFT JOIN C1_FT_EXT_CHAR uftgl ON  uftgl.FT_ID      = ft.FT_ID
                               AND uftgl.CHAR_TYPE_CD = 'CM-UFTGL'
LEFT JOIN C1_FT_EXT_CHAR glat  ON  glat.FT_ID       = ft.FT_ID
                               AND glat.CHAR_TYPE_CD  = 'CMGLAT'
WHERE  ft.FROZEN_SW     = 'Y'
  AND  ft.FT_TYPE_FLG  IN ('BS','BX','AD','AX','PS','PX')
  AND  ft.ACCOUNTING_DT BETWEEN :period_start AND :period_end
  AND  (fp.FT_ID IS NULL OR ftgl.FT_ID IS NULL
        OR uftgl.FT_ID IS NULL OR glat.FT_ID IS NULL)
ORDER BY ft.ACCOUNTING_DT, ft.FT_ID;

tables.tableContent:
Issue | Where to Look | Resolution
FT not in CI_FT_PROC | CI_FT_PROC where FT_ID = :ft_id returns no rows | Verify FT is frozen (FROZEN_SW='Y'); check CM-GLDTL batch ran and included this FT type
CI_FT_GL rows not created | CI_FT_GL where FT_ID = :ft_id returns no rows | Check CI_FT_PROC exists first; investigate batch error log
GL_ACCT still blank on CI_FT_GL | CI_FT_GL.GL_ACCT is empty or spaces | GLASSGN has not run or errored — check C1_FT_EXT_CHAR for CMGLAT row; verify CM_GL_ACCT_TEMPLATE_LINE has entry for DST_ID
VALIDATE_SW = 'N' on CI_FT_GL | CI_FT_GL.VALIDATE_SW | GL account validation failed on GLA_VAL_DT — check GL account configuration
CM-UFTGL not processed | No C1_FT_EXT_CHAR row with CHAR_TYPE_CD='CM-UFTGL' | Check CM-UFTGL batch run in CI_BATCH_RUN; re-run if missing
GLASSGN not processed | No C1_FT_EXT_CHAR row with CHAR_TYPE_CD='CMGLAT' | Check GLASSGN batch; verify CM_GL_ACCT_TEMPLATE_LINE has valid DST_ID matching CI_FT_GL.DST_ID
GL summary amounts wrong | CI_FT_GL.AMOUNT vs CI_FT.CUR_AMT mismatch | Check CR_DR_FLG on CM_GL_ACCT_TEMPLATE_LINE — debit/credit signs may be reversed
Duplicate CI_FT_GL rows | Multiple rows with same FT_ID + GL_SEQ_NBR | CM-UFTGL may have run twice; investigate and remove duplicates with DBA
FT in CI_FT_PROC but missing from XML output | CM-GLDTL batch log | Check VALIDATE_SW='Y' and GL_ACCT is populated on all CI_FT_GL rows for the FT

sectionPath: 9. Member Premium — Billable Charges & Pricing Calculation
text: Member premium charges flow through a billable charge pipeline that connects CI_MEMBERSHIP to calculated premium amounts via a pricing engine. The billable charge (CI_BILL_CHG) is the central record — it links to the membership via a characteristic, carries the service quantity (billed amount), and is processed by the pricing engine which calculates the final premium and stores it in CI_PRCE_CALC and CI_PRCE_CALC_LN.

tables.tableDescription: Member premium charges flow through a billable charge pipeline that connects CI_MEMBERSHIP to calculated premium amounts via a pricing engine. The billable charge (CI_BILL_CHG) is the central record — it links to the membership via a characteristic, carries the service quantity (billed amount), and is processed by the pricing engine which calculates the final premium and stores it in CI_PRCE_CALC and CI_PRCE_CALC_LN.
tables.tableContent:
Table | Key Columns Used | Description
CI_BILL_CHG | BILLABLE_CHG_ID, START_DT, END_DT, BILLABLE_CHG_STAT | Billable charge record. BILLABLE_CHG_STAT='10' = Active/Pending billing.
CI_BILL_CHG_CHAR | BILLABLE_CHG_ID, CHAR_TYPE_CD, SRCH_CHAR_VAL | Characteristics on the billable charge. CHAR_TYPE_CD='C1MMBRSH' and SRCH_CHAR_VAL=MEMBERSHIP_ID links the charge to the member.

CI_PRCE_CALC | PRCE_CALC_ID, BILLABLE_CHG_ID, CALC_AMT, BO_STATUS_CD | Pricing calculation result. BO_STATUS_CD='C' = completed calculation. CALC_AMT is the calculated premium.

CI_PRICEITEM_PARM_GRP_K | PRICEITEM_PARM_GRP_ID, PARM_STR | Pricing parameter group — PARM_STR contains the rating parameters used to calculate premium (age band, rating area, plan tier, etc.).

sections.sectionTitle: 9.3 Query: Member Premium — Billable Charge with Pricing Calculation
sectionPath: 9. Member Premium — Billable Charges & Pricing Calculation
9.3 Query: Member Premium — Billable Charge with Pricing Calculation

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 9.3 Query: Member Premium — Billable Charge with Pricing Calculation
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Retrieve the full premium calculation for a specific membership, showing the billed amount, calculated premium, and pricing parameters.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Member premium: billable charge + pricing calculation
-- BILLABLE_CHG_STAT='10' = Active/Pending billing
-- CI_PRCE_CALC.BO_STATUS_CD='C' = completed pricing calculation
SELECT /*+ PARALLEL(32) */
    c.MEMBERSHIP_ID,
    c.START_DT                          AS membership_start,
    c.END_DT                            AS membership_end,
    c.BO_STATUS_CD                      AS membership_status,
    a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID,
    a.START_DT                          AS charge_start,
    a.END_DT                            AS charge_end,
    a.BILLABLE_CHG_STAT                 AS charge_status,
    a1.SVC_QTY                          AS billed_amount,
    pc.CALC_AMT                         AS calculated_premium,
    pc.BO_STATUS_CD                     AS pricing_status,
    parm.PARM_STR                       AS pricing_parameters
FROM   cisadm.CI_BILL_CHG               a
-- Billed amount (service quantity)
JOIN   cisadm.CI_BCHG_SQ                a1    ON  a1.BILLABLE_CHG_ID  = a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID
-- Link billable charge to membership via characteristic
JOIN   cisadm.CI_BILL_CHG_CHAR          b     ON  b.BILLABLE_CHG_ID   = a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID
                                              AND b.CHAR_TYPE_CD       = 'C1MMBRSH'
JOIN   cisadm.CI_MEMBERSHIP             c     ON  c.MEMBERSHIP_ID      = b.SRCH_CHAR_VAL
-- Completed pricing calculation
JOIN   cisadm.CI_PRCE_CALC              pc    ON  pc.BILLABLE_CHG_ID   = a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID
                                              AND pc.BO_STATUS_CD      = 'C'
-- Pricing calculation lines
JOIN   cisadm.CI_PRCE_CALC_LN           pcl   ON  pcl.PRCE_CALC_ID     = pc.PRCE_CALC_ID
-- Pricing parameter group (join on DESCR_ON_BILL cast to char)
JOIN   cisadm.CI_PRICEITEM_PARM_GRP_K   parm  ON  pcl.DESCR_ON_BILL
                                                    = TO_CHAR(parm.PRICEITEM_PARM_GRP_ID)
WHERE  c.MEMBERSHIP_ID      = :membership_id
  AND  a.BILLABLE_CHG_STAT  = '10'
ORDER BY a.START_DT, a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID;

sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Retrieve calculated premium totals for all memberships under a policy, using the Policy → Plan → Membership chain.

-- Premium summary for all memberships in a policy
SELECT DISTINCT  /*+ PARALLEL(32) */    po.POLICY_NBR,    pp.PLAN_ID,    pp.PLAN_NBR,    c.MEMBERSHIP_ID,    PCL.REFERENCE_ENTITY_ID PERID,    c.START_DT                          AS membership_start,    c.END_DT                            AS membership_end,    c.BO_STATUS_CD                      AS membership_status,    c.EXT_MEMBER_ID,    a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID,    a.START_DT                          AS charge_start,    a.END_DT                            AS charge_end,    a1.SVC_QTY                          AS billed_amount,    pcL.CALC_AMT                         AS calculated_premium,    parm.PARM_STR                       AS pricing_parametersFROM   cisadm.CI_POLICY                 poJOIN   cisadm.CI_POLICY_PER             pol_per  ON  pol_per.POLICY_ID      = po.POLICY_IDJOIN   cisadm.CI_POLICY_PLAN            pp       ON  pp.POLICY_ID           = po.POLICY_IDJOIN   cisadm.CI_MEMBERSHIP             c        ON  c.PLAN_ID              = pp.PLAN_ID-- Membership → billable charge via characteristicJOIN   cisadm.CI_BILL_CHG_CHAR          b        ON  b.SRCH_CHAR_VAL        = c.MEMBERSHIP_ID                                                 AND b.CHAR_TYPE_CD         = 'C1MMBRSH'JOIN   cisadm.CI_BILL_CHG               a        ON  a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID      = b.BILLABLE_CHG_ID                                                 AND a.BILLABLE_CHG_STAT    = '10'JOIN   cisadm.CI_BCHG_SQ                a1       ON  a1.BILLABLE_CHG_ID     = a.BILLABLE_CHG_IDJOIN   cisadm.CI_PRCE_CALC              pc       ON  pc.BILLABLE_CHG_ID     = a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID                                                 AND pc.BO_STATUS_CD        = 'C'JOIN   cisadm.CI_PRCE_CALC_LN           pcl      ON  pcl.PRCE_CALC_ID       = pc.PRCE_CALC_IDJOIN   cisadm.CI_PRICEITEM_PARM_GRP_K   parm     ON  pcl.DESCR_ON_BILL                                                      = TO_CHAR(parm.PRICEITEM_PARM_GRP_ID)WHERE  po.POLICY_NBR =:policynbrORDER BY pp.PLAN_NBR, c.MEMBERSHIP_ID, a.START_DT;

9.5 Query: Premium with Full Member and Coverage Context

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 9.5 Query: Premium with Full Member and Coverage Context
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Extend the premium query with member name, RMRN, SA coverage dates, and bill group context for a complete member premium view.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Full member premium view with member details and coverage context
SELECT /*+ PARALLEL(32) */
    -- Group context
    pn_pg.ENTITY_NAME                      AS parent_group_name,
    pn_bg.ENTITY_NAME                      AS bill_group_name,
    -- Member details
    c.MEMBERSHIP_ID,
    c.START_DT                          AS membership_start,
    c.END_DT                            AS membership_end,
    c.BO_STATUS_CD                      AS membership_status,
    c.EXT_MEMBER_ID,
    pn_p.ENTITY_NAME                       AS member_name,
    p.BIRTH_DT                          AS date_of_birth,
    pid_rmrn.PER_ID_NBR                 AS rmrn,
    -- Coverage SA
    sa.SA_ID,
    sa.SA_TYPE_CD                       AS plan_type,
    sa.START_DT                         AS coverage_start,
    sa.END_DT                           AS coverage_end,
    -- Billable charge
    a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID,
    a.START_DT                          AS charge_start,
    a.END_DT                            AS charge_end,
    a1.SVC_QTY                          AS billed_amount,
    -- Pricing calculation
    pcl.CALC_AMT                         AS calculated_premium,
    parm.PARM_STR                       AS pricing_parameters,
    an_a_acct.ACCT_NBR,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a_acct.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 1)  AS region,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a_acct.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 2)  AS grp,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_a_acct.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 3)  AS subgroup
FROM   cisadm.CI_MEMBERSHIP             c
-- Member person record
JOIN   cisadm.CI_MEMBERSHIP_PER         mp      ON  mp.MEMBERSHIP_ID        = c.MEMBERSHIP_ID
JOIN   cisadm.CI_PER                    p       ON  p.PER_ID                = mp.PER_ID
                                                AND p.PER_OR_BUS_FLG        = 'P'
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_PER_NAME           pn_p  ON  pn_p.PER_ID       = p.PER_ID
                                             AND pn_p.PRIM_NAME_SW = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_PER_ID              pid_rmrn ON pid_rmrn.PER_ID         = p.PER_ID
                                                AND pid_rmrn.ID_TYPE_CD        = 'RMRN'
-- Coverage SA
JOIN   cisadm.CI_MEMBERSHIP_SA          ms      ON  ms.MEMBERSHIP_ID        = c.MEMBERSHIP_ID
JOIN   cisadm.CI_SA                     sa      ON  sa.SA_ID                = ms.SA_ID
-- Bill group context
JOIN   cisadm.CI_ACCT                   a_acct  ON  a_acct.ACCT_ID          = sa.ACCT_ID
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_ACCT_NBR           an_a_acct  ON  an_a_acct.ACCT_ID = a_acct.ACCT_ID
                                             AND an_a_acct.PRIM_SW   = 'Y'
JOIN   cisadm.CI_ACCT_PER               ap      ON  ap.ACCT_ID              = a_acct.ACCT_ID
JOIN   cisadm.CI_PER                    bg      ON  bg.PER_ID               = ap.PER_ID
                                                AND bg.PER_OR_BUS_FLG       = 'BG'
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_PER_NAME           pn_bg  ON  pn_bg.PER_ID       = bg.PER_ID
                                             AND pn_bg.PRIM_NAME_SW = 'Y'
JOIN   cisadm.CI_PER_PER                pp_link ON  pp_link.PER_ID2         = bg.PER_ID
JOIN   cisadm.CI_PER                    pg      ON  pg.PER_ID               = pp_link.PER_ID1
                                                AND pg.PER_OR_BUS_FLG       = 'PG'
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_PER_NAME           pn_pg  ON  pn_pg.PER_ID       = pg.PER_ID
                                             AND pn_pg.PRIM_NAME_SW = 'Y'
-- Billable charge via membership characteristic
JOIN   cisadm.CI_BILL_CHG_CHAR          b       ON  b.SRCH_CHAR_VAL         = c.MEMBERSHIP_ID
                                                AND b.CHAR_TYPE_CD          = 'C1MMBRSH'
JOIN   cisadm.CI_BILL_CHG               a       ON  a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID       = b.BILLABLE_CHG_ID
                                                AND a.BILLABLE_CHG_STAT     = '10'
JOIN   cisadm.CI_BCHG_SQ                a1      ON  a1.BILLABLE_CHG_ID      = a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID
-- Pricing
JOIN   cisadm.CI_PRCE_CALC              pc      ON  pc.BILLABLE_CHG_ID      = a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID
                                                AND pc.BO_STATUS_CD         = 'C'
JOIN   cisadm.CI_PRCE_CALC_LN           pcl     ON  pcl.PRCE_CALC_ID        = pc.PRCE_CALC_ID
JOIN   cisadm.CI_PRICEITEM_PARM_GRP_K   parm    ON  pcl.DESCR_ON_BILL
                                                     = TO_CHAR(parm.PRICEITEM_PARM_GRP_ID)
WHERE  c.MEMBERSHIP_ID = :membership_id
ORDER BY a.START_DT;

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 9.6 Query: Memberships with No Completed Pricing Calculation
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Identify active billable charges where the pricing calculation has not completed — useful for investigating missing or stuck premiums.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Active billable charges with no completed pricing calculation
SELECT
    b.SRCH_CHAR_VAL                     AS membership_id,
    mem.START_DT                        AS membership_start,
    mem.END_DT                          AS membership_end,
    mem.BO_STATUS_CD                    AS membership_status,
    a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID,
    a.START_DT                          AS charge_start,
    a.END_DT                            AS charge_end,
    a.BILLABLE_CHG_STAT                 AS charge_status,
    a1.SVC_QTY                          AS billed_amount,
    pc.BO_STATUS_CD                     AS pricing_status,  -- NULL if no calc exists
    pc.PRCE_CALC_ID
FROM   cisadm.CI_BILL_CHG               a
JOIN   cisadm.CI_BCHG_SQ                a1   ON  a1.BILLABLE_CHG_ID  = a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID
JOIN   cisadm.CI_BILL_CHG_CHAR          b    ON  b.BILLABLE_CHG_ID   = a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID
                                             AND b.CHAR_TYPE_CD      = 'C1MMBRSH'
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_MEMBERSHIP          mem  ON  mem.MEMBERSHIP_ID   = b.SRCH_CHAR_VAL
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_PRCE_CALC           pc   ON  pc.BILLABLE_CHG_ID  = a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID
                                             AND pc.BO_STATUS_CD     = 'C'
WHERE  a.BILLABLE_CHG_STAT = '10'
  AND  pc.PRCE_CALC_ID     IS NULL           -- no completed calculation
ORDER BY a.START_DT, a.BILLABLE_CHG_ID
FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY;

sectionPath: 9. Member Premium — Billable Charges & Pricing Calculation
text: Enrollment triggers charge creation — When a member is enrolled and a coverage SA is activated, the billing engine creates a CI_BILL_CHG record for the coverage period. The membership is linked to the charge via CI_BILL_CHG_CHAR with CHAR_TYPE_CD = 'C1MMBRSH'.
Service quantity set — CI_BCHG_SQ is populated with SVC_QTY representing the billable premium quantity for the period.

Pricing engine runs — The pricing engine evaluates the billable charge against the applicable pricing rules (from C1_PRC_RULE via CI_POLICY_PLAN) and creates a CI_PRCE_CALC record. BO_STATUS_CD is set to 'C' (complete) when the calculation succeeds. CALC_AMT holds the final calculated premium.

Pricing parameters recorded — CI_PRCE_CALC_LN records each calculation line. DESCR_ON_BILL holds the PRICEITEM_PARM_GRP_ID linking to CI_PRICEITEM_PARM_GRP_K, which stores the full pricing parameter string (PARM_STR) — the combination of age band, rating area, plan tier, and other factors that drove the premium calculation.

Bill segment generated — Once pricing is complete, the billing engine picks up the billable charge and generates a CI_BSEG (bill segment) and corresponding CI_FT (financial transaction) entries that appear on the member's bill.

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 10.1 Overview
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Delinquency processing manages the lifecycle of accounts that have failed to pay premiums on time. ORMB tracks each delinquency event as a CM_DELIN_PROC record, linked to the account via CM_DELIN_PROC_REL_OBJ. As the delinquency progresses through status transitions, each step is logged in CM_DELIN_PROC_LOG. Outbound notifications sent to external systems (exchange, CMS, enrollment system) are tracked via F1_OUTMSG, linked from the log via CHAR_VAL_FK1.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
CM_DELIN_PROC (CM_DELIN_PROC_ID, CM_DELIN_PROC_TYP_CD, BO_STATUS_CD)
  │
  ├── CM_DELIN_PROC_REL_OBJ (MAINT_OBJ_CD='ACCOUNT', PK_VALUE1=ACCT_ID)
  │         └── CI_ACCT (ACCT_ID, CUST_CL_CD)
  │
  └── CM_DELIN_PROC_LOG (SEQNO, LOG_ENTRY_TYPE_FLG, LOG_DTTM,
          BO_STATUS_CD, DESCRLONG, CHAR_TYPE_CD, CHAR_VAL_FK1)
          latest entry = MAX(SEQNO)
          │
          └── F1_OUTMSG (OUTMSG_ID = CHAR_VAL_FK1)  ← LEFT JOIN
                outbound notification to external system
                OUTMSG_TYPE_CD, OUTMSG_STATUS_FLG,
                CRE_DTTM, XML_SOURCE, XML_RESPONSE

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 10.5 Query: Delinquency Status with Latest Log Entry and Outbound Message
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Your confirmed base query — returns current delinquency status, latest log entry, and any outbound notification sent to external systems.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Delinquency process with latest log entry and outbound notification
SELECT /*+ PARALLEL(32) */
    acct.ACCT_ID,
    acct.CUST_CL_CD,
    dp.CM_DELIN_PROC_ID,
    dp.CM_DELIN_PROC_TYP_CD,
    dp.BO_STATUS_CD                     AS proc_status,
    dp.BO_STATUS_REASON_CD              AS proc_status_reason,
    dp.CRE_DTTM                         AS proc_created,
    dp.STATUS_UPD_DTTM                  AS proc_last_updated,
    -- Latest log entry
    log.SEQNO                           AS latest_log_seq,
    log.LOG_ENTRY_TYPE_FLG              AS log_entry_type,
    log.LOG_DTTM                        AS log_datetime,
    log.BO_STATUS_CD                    AS log_status,
    log.DESCRLONG                       AS log_description,
    log.CHAR_TYPE_CD,
    log.CHAR_VAL_FK1                    AS outmsg_id,
    log.USER_ID                         AS log_user,
    -- Outbound message to external system (if sent)
    msg.OUTMSG_TYPE_CD,
    msg.OUTMSG_STATUS_FLG               AS msg_status,
    msg.OUTMSG_PROC_METH_FLG            AS msg_processing_method,
    msg.NT_XID_CD                       AS notification_type,
    msg.CRE_DTTM                        AS msg_created,
    msg.BATCH_CD                        AS msg_batch_cd,
    msg.BATCH_NBR                       AS msg_batch_nbr,
    an_acct.ACCT_NBR,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_acct.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 1)  AS region,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_acct.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 2)  AS grp,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(an_acct.ACCT_NBR, '[^-]+', 1, 3)  AS subgroup
FROM   cisadm.CM_DELIN_PROC             dp
-- Link to account via related object
JOIN   cisadm.CM_DELIN_PROC_REL_OBJ    rel  ON  rel.CM_DELIN_PROC_ID  = dp.CM_DELIN_PROC_ID
                                             AND rel.MAINT_OBJ_CD      = 'ACCOUNT'
JOIN   cisadm.CI_ACCT                  acct ON  acct.ACCT_ID           = rel.PK_VALUE1
LEFT JOIN cisadm.CI_ACCT_NBR           an_acct  ON  an_acct.ACCT_ID = acct.ACCT_ID
                                             AND an_acct.PRIM_SW   = 'Y'
-- Latest log entry only via MAX(SEQNO)
JOIN   cisadm.CM_DELIN_PROC_LOG        log  ON  log.CM_DELIN_PROC_ID   = dp.CM_DELIN_PROC_ID
                                             AND log.SEQNO = (
                                                 SELECT MAX(e.SEQNO)
                                                 FROM   cisadm.CM_DELIN_PROC_LOG e
                                                 WHERE  e.CM_DELIN_PROC_ID = dp.CM_DELIN_PROC_ID
                                             )
-- Outbound message (only present if notification was sent)
LEFT JOIN cisadm.F1_OUTMSG             msg  ON  msg.OUTMSG_ID          = log.CHAR_VAL_FK1
WHERE  dp.BO_STATUS_CD = :status_cd     -- e.g. 'SENDDUNLTR', 'SENDWRNLTR', 'REQTERM'
ORDER BY dp.CRE_DTTM DESC;

FROM   cisadm.CM_DELIN_PROC             dp

JOIN   cisadm.CI_ACCT                  acct ON  acct.ACCT_ID           = rel.PK_VALUE1

text: Premium not received — Account balance remains unpaid after the due date. The delinquency batch identifies overdue accounts and creates a CM_DELIN_PROC record with the appropriate CM_DELIN_PROC_TYP_CD based on the account's enrollment type (APTC, off-exchange, direct billed, etc.).

Dunning letter stage (SENDDUNLTR) — The process transitions to SENDDUNLTR. An outbound notification is sent via F1_OUTMSG (e.g. to the exchange or member portal). The log entry is written to CM_DELIN_PROC_LOG with CHAR_VAL_FK1 = OUTMSG_ID.

Warning letter stage (SENDWRNLTR) — If premium remains unpaid, the process advances to SENDWRNLTR. A second outbound notification is sent. A new log entry is written with the updated status and message reference.

Termination request (REQTERM) — If still unpaid, the process advances to REQTERM. A termination request is sent to the external system (exchange, CMS) via F1_OUTMSG. The SA coverage end date may be updated at this point.

Resolution — The process ends in one of three terminal states:CLOSED — Termination completed, coverage ended.CANCELLED — Process cancelled (e.g. payment received, error, manual override).REINSTATED — Member paid arrears and coverage was reinstated.

tables.tableDescription: Resolution — The process ends in one of three terminal states:CLOSED — Termination completed, coverage ended.CANCELLED — Process cancelled (e.g. payment received, error, manual override).REINSTATED — Member paid arrears and coverage was reinstated.
tables.tableContent:
Issue | Where to Look | Resolution
Delinquency process not created for overdue account | CM_DELIN_PROC joined via CM_DELIN_PROC_REL_OBJ to ACCT_ID | Check delinquency batch ran; verify account customer class is configured for delinquency processing
Process stuck in SENDDUNLTR or SENDWRNLTR | CM_DELIN_PROC.STATUS_UPD_DTTM vs current date | Check next scheduled batch; review BO_DATA_AREA for processing errors
Outbound message not sent | CM_DELIN_PROC_LOG.CHAR_VAL_FK1 is blank | Notification not triggered — check process configuration; verify F1_OUTMSG record exists
F1_OUTMSG in error | F1_OUTMSG.OUTMSG_STATUS_FLG and ERROR_DTL | Review ERROR_DTL CLOB for external system error; reprocess or resend message
REQTERM sent but SA not terminated | CI_SA.SA_STATUS_FLG and END_DT | External system may not have confirmed termination; check F1_OUTMSG.XML_RESPONSE
Process in REQTERM but should be REINSTATED | CM_DELIN_PROC.BO_STATUS_CD | Payment may have been received after termination request — check CI_PAY for the account and manually reinstate if appropriate
Duplicate delinquency processes for same account | Multiple CM_DELIN_PROC rows via CM_DELIN_PROC_REL_OBJ for same ACCT_ID | Investigate batch deduplication; cancel the duplicate process
Wrong process type assigned | CM_DELIN_PROC.CM_DELIN_PROC_TYP_CD | APTC vs non-APTC mismatch — check member's subsidy status and account configuration

text: Receive Enrollment Data — Inbound 834 EDI or manual entry initiates the process.
Confirm Parent Group — Verify the employer's CI_PER record exists with PER_OR_BUS_FLG = 'PG' and the correct RGI in CI_PER_ID.
Confirm or Create Bill Group — Verify or create the BG person record. Link to the PG via CI_PER_PER.
Create Account — Link the Bill Group to a CI_ACCT via CI_ACCT_PER. Set billing cycle and customer class.
Create Coverage SA — Create the Service Agreement on the account. Assign rate schedule (RATE_CD) and coverage start date.
Create Membership — Create a CI_MEMBERSHIP record with EXT_MEMBER_ID. Link to the SA via CI_MEMBERSHIP_SA and to the Policy Plan via PLAN_ID.
Create Member Person Records — Create CI_PER records (PER_OR_BUS_FLG = 'P') for subscriber and dependents. Store RMRN and SSN in CI_PER_ID. Link all members to the membership via CI_MEMBERSHIP_PER.
✅ Verify: Run Query 5.2 to confirm all members appear under the membership. Run Query 5.6 to confirm the SA is Active with the correct rate schedule.
Navigate to the Bill Group account via Customer Info → Account.
Confirm the coverage SA is Active with a valid rate schedule.
Click Generate Bill or allow the monthly billing batch to run automatically.
Review the bill segment — confirm the premium amount is correct for the billing period.
Use the Rate Check tool if the amount looks incorrect.
Click Complete to freeze the bill and generate Financial Transactions.
Confirm the bill is in Complete status with the correct TOT_AMT_DUE.
⚠️ Completing a bill requires a cancel/rebill to correct. Always verify before completing — especially after enrollment changes or rate schedule updates.
Pre-Billing Reconciliation — Confirm all mid-month member adds, terminations, and plan changes are processed in the system before the billing batch runs.
Pro-Ration — For members added or terminated mid-month, the system calculates pro-rated premium based on days in the coverage period.
Billing Batch — The batch aggregates all active SAs under each Bill Group account and generates bills.
Review Bills — Review generated bills per Bill Group account. Confirm headcount and total premium are correct against enrollment records.
Generate 820 EDI — Produce and transmit the 820 Premium Payment Remittance Advice to the employer group.
Complete Bills — Once reconciled, complete bills to freeze charges.
Process the Change — Update the SA effective dates or rate schedule to reflect the coverage change.
Identify Affected Periods — Determine which prior billing periods fall within the retroactive effective date.
Cancel Affected Bill Segments — Cancel segments for impacted periods. Offsetting FTs are created automatically.
Regenerate Segments — The system recalculates premium for affected periods under the new terms.
Net Adjustment — The credit or debit difference appears on the next bill as a retroactive adjustment (FT_TYPE_FLG = 'AD').
📝 Retro adjustments beyond a configurable lookback period require supervisor approval. Check your organization's retro adjustment policy.
Confirm Credit Balance — Use Query 5.5 or Query 5.9 to verify the account has an overpayment or credit FT.
Create Adjustment — Navigate to the SA and add a credit adjustment using the appropriate Adjustment Type for premium refund.
Initiate Refund — Navigate to Payments → Refund Request → Add. Link the credit FT and specify the refund method (ACH, check, or credit to next bill).
Approve & Process — Refunds above the configured threshold require supervisor approval before the refund batch processes the payment.
Verify — Confirm the refund FT appears in Query 5.9 and the account balance is correct.

sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Rate schedules are effective date-controlled. A new CI_RATE_VER record must be created for each plan year. ORMB uses the version in effect on the bill segment's start date.

FROM   CI_RATE      r

text: Upload Requests provide a controlled, auditable mechanism for bulk data operations — adjustments, billable charges, refunds, write-offs, GL corrections, and balance transfers — without requiring direct table manipulation. Each upload is submitted as a file, creates a C1_UPLOAD_REQ header record, individual detail rows in C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS, and transitions through a BO status lifecycle. Types with W/APPR in the name require explicit approval before processing.
Approved Templates
ORMB Templates

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 16.1 Data Model
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: ORMB Templates
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
C1_UPLOAD_REQ  (UPLOAD_REQ_ID)
  │   C1_UPL_REQ_TYPE_CD  — identifies the upload type (see 17.3)
  │   BUS_OBJ_CD          — Business Object driving the lifecycle
  │   BO_STATUS_CD        — current lifecycle status
  │   BO_STATUS_REASON_CD — reason for current status
  │   FILE_NAME           — source file name
  │   COMMENTS            — submitter notes
  │   CRE_DTTM            — when the request was created
  │   STATUS_UPD_DTTM     — when status last changed
  │   BO_DATA_AREA        — CLOB: additional request-level data
  │
  ├── C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS  (UPLOAD_REQ_ID, UPLOAD_DTL_ID)
  │     One row per line in the uploaded file
  │     FIELD_1 .. FIELD_10  — raw field values from the upload file
  │     REC_STATUS_FLG        — per-line processing status
  │     ENTITY_ID             — ID of the entity created/updated by this line
  │     ENTITY_DESC           — description of that entity
  │     BO_DATA_AREA          — CLOB: parsed/processed detail for this line
  │     │
  │     └── C1_UPLOAD_REQ_EXCP  (UPLOAD_DTL_ID, SEQNO)
  │           One row per error on a detail line
  │           MESSAGE_CAT_NBR, MESSAGE_NBR  — error message identifiers
  │           MESSAGE_PARM1..9              — error message parameters
  │
  └── C1_UPLOAD_REQ_CHAR  (UPLOAD_REQ_ID, CHAR_TYPE_CD, EFFDT)
        Characteristics on the upload request header
        CHAR_VAL, ADHOC_CHAR_VAL, SRCH_CHAR_VAL
        CHAR_VAL_FK1..FK5

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 16.4 Approval Workflow
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: Types with W/APPR in the C1_UPL_REQ_TYPE_CD require an explicit approval step before the batch processes the lines. The lifecycle transitions through BO_STATUS_CD on C1_UPLOAD_REQ:
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
File submitted
  │
  ▼
PENDING / SUBMITTED
  │   Upload request created, detail lines loaded into C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS
  │   System validates file structure; per-line errors written to C1_UPLOAD_REQ_EXCP
  │
  ▼
PENDING APPROVAL          ← W/APPR types only
  │   Approver reviews C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS lines and exceptions
  │   Can REJECT → BO_STATUS_CD = REJECTED (terminal)
  │
  ▼
APPROVED                  ← W/APPR types only after approval; non-W/APPR skip to here
  │
  ▼
IN PROGRESS               ← Batch picks up and processes each detail line
  │   C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS.ENTITY_ID populated on success
  │   C1_UPLOAD_REQ_EXCP rows written on line failure
  │   C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS.REC_STATUS_FLG updated per line
  │
  ├── PROCESSED           ← All lines succeeded
  ├── PROCESSED WITH ERRORS ← Some lines failed
  └── REJECTED / ERROR    ← Fatal processing failure

tables.tableDescription: The upload processing batch reads C1_UPLOAD_REQ where BO_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED' (or equivalent ready-to-process status) and processes each C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS row according to the C1_UPL_REQ_TYPE_CD logic:

Billable charge upload (CM_BC_*) | CI_BILL_CHG + CI_BCHG_SQ per line | CI_BILL_CHG, CI_BCHG_SQ, CI_BILL_CHG_CHAR
Balance transfer (CM_BAL_XFER_ACCT) | FT transfer entries between SAs/accounts | CI_FT, CI_SA
GL location value (GL_LOC_VAL_*) | GL string location configuration records | GL location tables
FT Audit (FT_AUDIT_*) | Audit records against existing FTs | CI_FT, audit tables
Rate/mapping uploads (CM_KPIC_*, CM_TPA_*) | Rate or mapping configuration rows | Custom rating tables

sqlStatements.sqlSectionTitle: 17.6.1 Upload Request Status Summary
sqlStatements.sqlDescription: On success, C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS.ENTITY_ID is populated with the ID of the created record (e.g. ADJ_ID, BILLABLE_CHG_ID). On failure, C1_UPLOAD_REQ_EXCP rows are written with message codes that resolve via CI_MSG.
sqlStatements.sqlStatement:
-- Status of all upload requests — most recent first
SELECT
    ur.UPLOAD_REQ_ID,
    ur.C1_UPL_REQ_TYPE_CD,
    ur.FILE_NAME,
    ur.BO_STATUS_CD,
    ur.BO_STATUS_REASON_CD,
    ur.COMMENTS,
    ur.CRE_DTTM,
    ur.STATUS_UPD_DTTM,
    COUNT(dtl.UPLOAD_DTL_ID)            AS total_lines,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dtl.REC_STATUS_FLG = 'COMP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processed_lines,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dtl.REC_STATUS_FLG = 'ERR'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_lines
FROM   cisadm.C1_UPLOAD_REQ            ur
LEFT JOIN cisadm.C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS    dtl ON dtl.UPLOAD_REQ_ID = ur.UPLOAD_REQ_ID
GROUP BY
    ur.UPLOAD_REQ_ID, ur.C1_UPL_REQ_TYPE_CD, ur.FILE_NAME,
    ur.BO_STATUS_CD, ur.BO_STATUS_REASON_CD, ur.COMMENTS,
    ur.CRE_DTTM, ur.STATUS_UPD_DTTM
ORDER BY ur.CRE_DTTM DESC
FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;

tables.tableContent:
Symptom | Where to Look | Resolution
Upload stuck in PENDING / PNDAPPR | C1_UPLOAD_REQ.BO_STATUS_CD and CRE_DTTM | Awaiting approver action — notify the approving squad; check if approver is aware
Upload submitted but no detail lines | C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS count for UPLOAD_REQ_ID | File parsing failed — check BO_DATA_AREA on C1_UPLOAD_REQ for error detail

ENTITY_ID null on processed line | C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS.REC_STATUS_FLG and BO_DATA_AREA | Record not created — processing error; check exceptions table
Upload approved but batch not processing | C1_UPLOAD_REQ.BO_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED' with old STATUS_UPD_DTTM | Upload processing batch has not run — check CI_BATCH_RUN for the relevant batch job
