tables.tableDescription: This knowledge base was compiled from ORMB KT Session 2 (March 2022), KPIF On Workflow Walkthrough (August 2022), E2E Test Results, and UTP documentation for Defect 322154.
tables.tableContent:
Term | Definition
Parent Group (PG) | Employer entity in CI_PER with PER_OR_BUS_FLG = 'PG'. Owns the Policy; top of the group hierarchy.
Bill Group (BG) | Billing sub-unit in CI_PER with PER_OR_BUS_FLG = 'BG'. Linked to PG via CI_PER_PER and to billing account via CI_ACCT_PER.
Member (P) | Individual person in CI_PER with PER_OR_BUS_FLG = 'P'. Enrolled via CI_MEMBERSHIP_PER.
CI_PER_PER | Join table linking a Parent Group (PER_ID1) to its Bill Groups (PER_ID2).
RGI | Regional Group Identifier — external group ID stored in CI_PER_ID with ID_TYPE_CD = 'RGI'. Parent Group (PG) only.
BLGRPID | Bill Group Identifier — external ID stored in CI_PER_ID with ID_TYPE_CD = 'BLGRPID'. Bill Group (BG) only.
RMRN | Regional Member Record Number — external member ID stored in CI_PER_ID with ID_TYPE = 'RMRN'.
SSN | Social Security Number — stored in CI_PER_ID with ID_TYPE = 'SSN'. PHI — handle with care.
Membership | CI_MEMBERSHIP record representing a subscriber enrollment. Contains EXT_MEMBER_ID and PLAN_ID.
CI_MEMBERSHIP_PER | Join table listing all persons (subscribers and dependents) under a membership. Links to CI_PER.
CI_MEMBERSHIP_SA | Join table linking a Membership to its coverage Service Agreement(s) in CI_SA.
Policy | CI_POLICY — umbrella coverage contract for an employer group. Linked to PG via CI_POLICY_PER.
CI_POLICY_PLAN | Links a Policy to one or more Plans. PLAN_ID ties back to CI_MEMBERSHIP.
SA | Service Agreement — the coverage record in CI_SA. Linked to CI_ACCT via ACCT_ID.
BSEG | Bill Segment — calculated premium charge for one SA for one billing period, stored in CI_BSEG.
FT | Financial Transaction in CI_FT. Types: BS (Bill Seg), BX (Bill Seg Cancel), PS (Pay Seg), PX (Pay Seg Cancel), AD (Adjustment), AX (Adj Cancel). SIBLING_ID points to BSEG_ID or ADJ_ID depending on type.
Rate Schedule | CI_RATE — defines how premiums are calculated. Attached to SA via RATE_CD. Versioned via CI_RATE_VER.
OE | Open Enrollment — annual period when members can enroll or change plans.
SEP | Special Enrollment Period — enrollment window triggered by a qualifying life event.
COBRA | Federal law allowing continuation of employer group coverage after employment ends.
MLR | Medical Loss Ratio — percentage of premiums spent on healthcare vs. administration.
Upload Request | A bulk data operation submitted via C1_UPLOAD_REQ. Each request has a type (C1_UPL_REQ_TYPE_CD), a file, and a BO lifecycle status. Detail lines are stored in C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS.
W/APPR | Suffix on upload type codes indicating the request requires explicit approver action before the batch will process the lines.
REC_STATUS_FLG | Per-line processing status on C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS. COMP = successfully processed; ERR = failed — see C1_UPLOAD_REQ_EXCP for error details.
ENTITY_ID | Column on C1_UPLOAD_REQ_DTLS populated after processing with the ID of the record created (e.g. ADJ_ID, BILLABLE_CHG_ID).
LIS | Low Income Subsidy — federal subsidy for Medicare Part D. LIS refund uploads handle premium credits for qualifying members.
Write-Off/On | Accounting action to remove (WO) or restore (ON) an uncollectable balance from a SA. Processed via WO_UPL_REQ_TYPE_W/APPR upload types.
TPA | Third-Party Administrator. CM_TPA_RATES_UPLD automates carrier compensation rate loading for MOC (Managed Operations Contract) arrangements.
KPIC | Kaiser Permanente Insurance Company. CM_KPIC_* upload types handle percentage mapping and product overrides specific to KPIC arrangements.
M3P | Medicare Prescription Payment Plan. CM_M3P_ADJ_UPL_REQ_TYPE_W/APPR handles adjustments on M3P service agreements.
TPA | Third-Party Administrator — administers health plan benefits on behalf of an insurer.
DOI | Department of Insurance — state regulatory body overseeing health plan rates and filings.
